title: Processor
summary: Background work as headless isolates, placed by the balancer: a playground where you set each task's CPU and watch it move between worker pools, and a simulated file processor whose processors share their work through consumer groups.

result.line: On 4 cores at 50 files a second, the balancer runs 8 light processors as one pool: 2 workers against 9, 17 points less CPU and 47 MB less memory, at a p95 latency of 158 ms against 39 ms. With faults (blocking, heavy and crashing files) it moves them apart and gets through 44 files a second against one pool's 27, at the cost of files done twice when it moves them; a worker per processor keeps the lowest latency.
